## Investigation Summary

I reviewed the case snapshot, listed all evidence (3 items), expanded the evidence projections, checked the causal/dependency graphs, searched knowledge, compared evidence across dimensions, and inspected the collector catalog.

**What the evidence shows** (all ACTIVE, COMPLETE, same aligned window T0..T1, 120 samples each, observations tagged `spool/disk/retries`):
- `ev-23-01` — `filesystem_usage` elevated (3.941)
- `ev-23-02` — `device_latency` elevated (3.972)
- `ev-23-03` — `retry_rate` elevated (4.003)

All three signals are consistently elevated (~4σ), temporally aligned, and match the case-goal mechanism (full local spool → I/O delay → retries → extra network traffic). Causal/dependency graphs and evidence gaps are empty. Knowledge search returned only an unrelated `checkout-api` RAG case (`knowledge_is_evidence=false`, not usable as evidence).
